scenes.scene: A young shop owner in a teal apron stands behind a small counter in a ten-square-meter milk tea shop, pressing five colored stickers onto a cup sleeve.
scenes.note: 店长在小店柜台后往杯套上贴五张彩色贴纸。

scenes.scene: The same young shop owner in a teal apron holds a red sticker beside a monthly rent bill pinned to the wall and a staff shift sheet.
scenes.note: 店长拿着红贴纸，旁边是墙上的月租账单和排班表。

scenes.scene: On a rainy Tuesday, the same young shop owner in a teal apron presses a thick stack of yellow and blue stickers onto a cup sleeve, peeling the white one half off.
scenes.note: 雨天生意冷清，店长把厚厚的黄色蓝色贴纸叠在杯套上，白贴纸只能撕掉一半。

scenes.scene: The same young shop owner in a teal apron scoops extra ice into a cup and sets two topping jars aside, a thin layer of milk foam on the drink.
scenes.note: 店长往杯里多加冰、撤走两罐小料，奶盖也变薄了。

scenes.scene: A customer in a gray hoodie pulls a suitcase and holds a milk tea cup at an airport counter, while the same young shop owner in a teal apron hands a delivery bag to a rider.
scenes.note: 机场柜台前顾客拖着行李箱拿奶茶，店长同时把外卖袋递给骑手。

scenes.scene: The customer in a gray hoodie points at the five colored stickers on a cup sleeve while the young shop owner in a teal apron explains at the counter.
scenes.note: 顾客指着杯套上的五张贴纸提问，店长在柜台边解释。
